_comment: Ceilings and the allowlist for the three ratchet gates. Ratcheted DOWN at
each unit boundary; PLAN.md section 6.5 carries the per-unit leak ceilings.
A ceiling that has to rise is a flag-and-proceed with the new number and the
forbiddenPatternAllowlist is APPEND-FORBIDDEN. Entries may only be removed
or lowered, and the gate enforces the lowering half itself: an entry that
allows more than is measured fails as STALE, so the ratchet cannot go slack
